title: Unit product grid
description: A big regular-weight two-line heading over a 2×2 grid of pale, nearly square-cornered cards with hairline borders: a title with a hairline arrow circle, a grey line, tinted capability pills and a product illustration at the foot. Each card warms to its own pastel (lilac, aqua, lime, mint) over 0.6s on hover. Cards stack on phones.
notes: media slot per card: a product illustration (626×398, contain) flush with the card's foot
